Bullish on sovereign AI. More countries are building their own AI.

Australia's is Agentaus 1 from Trellis Data. It's a 220B model that scores 84.4% on MMLU-Pro and runs on half the GPUs of similar-sized models.

It runs on Australian servers and never trains on your data.
